Every app on this phone goes through the tunnel. LAVRay itself always stays outside it.

All your data in one file: settings, servers with their passwords, groups, subscriptions (with their URLs) and your own routing presets. The file is encrypted with a password; without it, it cannot be opened.
The backup does not include the per-app tunnel choice or starting at phone boot: they are stored separately and stay as they were after a restore.

resources.string: No proxy at all. Handy for network diagnostics.
Maximum privacy: all traffic goes through the tunnel.
Local network goes direct, everything else through the proxy
Chinese sites and apps go direct, everything else through the proxy; DNS for China via your provider
RU sites and games go direct; AI services and everything else go through the proxy. Split DNS: RU & games via provider, the rest via DoH through the tunnel.
Try a different query or reset the filters
QR code for the link of “%1$s”
The link contains access keys: anyone who scans this code can use your server. Do not show it to others.
The link is too long for a QR code. Copy it and share it as text.
App rules with no effect on a phone: %1$s
These rules match a program by its process name (for example chrome.exe). A phone has no such processes, so they do nothing here. They stay in the preset and keep working on a computer.

Where your traffic goes right now
Your servers: search, tests and groups
Android can start the VPN by itself when the phone boots and bring it back if it stops. Turn it on in the system VPN settings, next to LAVRay.
LAVRay cannot see or change these switches: they belong to Android.
Could not read this value: the switch is unavailable.
Could not save the setting. The switch shows what is stored.

Usually you do not need to change this: while connected, LAVRay runs as a foreground service with a notification and uses no wake locks or timers. Some phone brands stop background apps anyway; if the connection drops while the screen is off, set LAVRay to “Unrestricted” or “Not optimized”. LAVRay cannot see brand-specific limits.
LAVRay is excluded from battery optimization.
Battery optimization is on for LAVRay (the default).
After connecting, the core opens the test address once through the server and warns you if nothing gets through.
Allow insecure TLS by default (don’t verify certificates)

LAVRay will stop verifying the TLS certificates of all servers. Your provider or anyone on the network path will be able to impersonate a server and read your traffic. Continue only if you trust your network and servers.

Certificates are not verified for any TLS server, even if the profile asks for verification: the connection can be impersonated and the traffic intercepted. Enable it only for your own servers with a self-signed certificate.
Certificate verification is off for all servers. The connection is not protected against server impersonation.

“Block connections without VPN” (lockdown) goes further: while the VPN is down, Android blocks the internet for every app. If your server is unavailable you have no connection until you reconnect or turn the switch off.
This change applies the next time the tunnel is built.
